Source-request differences and common shifts, n32 confirmation. Signed and absolute coherence contrasts are in nats; the request-dependent contrast cancels a request-independent shift.

Cache compatibility when input criteria differ. The shared-word conflicting-input primary and criterion-oriented margin are reported with context-bootstrap 95\% CIs.
